diagnostics.caveat: Zero request errors do not imply zero transport anomalies. Cumulative close counters include connections from previous samples. The pinned Envoy source overcounts SO_RXQ_OVFL; drop totals are not actual packet-loss counts.

source_findings.finding: Both recvmsg and recvmmsg add cumulative SO_RXQ_OVFL values repeatedly; upstream fix changes += to =.
